messages:
amy: Quick pulse ": propose a small regional roadshow to promote the Refkit tutorials + benchmark kit. target regions: NA, EU, APAC. goal: 3 local webinars, 3 localized landing pages, 100 signups total, 60 bench submissions. keep it low-friction.
rafael: love the regional approach. suggest we run 1-hour sessions locally timed + 30-min live bench demo. same repo & bench script for consistency.
priya: localization needs: copy + hero assets translated for EN/FR/JP (English small tweaks for NA vs EU). we'll need separate UTM per region: `utm_campaign=refkit_roadshow_{region}`.
seth: lead routing: single HubSpot form but add `region` hidden field and `utm_campaign`. Mapping: name|email|company|region|github|bench_url|utm_campaign. Then route to SFDC queue per region tag `roadshow_{region}_YYMM`.
gina: social plan: 3 region-specific promos + 1 global announcement. test two messaging angles per region: Tech (latency/cost) vs Stories (what devs built). do 50/50 split by region.
amy: bench kit: single `run_bench.py` -> output `results.json`. require schema: {"user":"handle","model":"redwood-1.5b","seq_len":"512","tokens":"512","p95_ms":"120"}. CLI example: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-1.5b --seq 512 --batch 4 --cpu --output results.json`. we'll provide a Colab + Docker fallback.
rafael: PR the repo with `/roadshow/{na,eu,apac}`, each with a tiny README localized and the same `/bench` script. GH Action: runs smoke bench on push to ensure example runs.
priya: landing pages: canonical + `?region=eu` redirect to localized content. simple form embed example: `<form action=\"https://lp.redwood.ai/roadshow/submit\" method=\"post\"> 
  <input name=\"name\"/> 
  <input name=\"email\"/> 
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"region\" value=\"EU\"/> 
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"utm_campaign\" value=\"refkit_roadshow_EU\"/> 
  <button>Register</button> 
</form>`
seth: analytics: track `utm_campaign`, `region`, `headline_variant`. build funnels per region: visit->signup->bench_submit->webinar_attend. create GA events and HubSpot lists per region.
gina: creatives: hero GIF variants (english/fr/jp), 1200x628 + vertical for IG. also short localized copy (headline <= 70 chars). design drop by Thursday.
amy: webinar logistics: 3 sessions: NA (1713600000), EU (1713640000), APAC (1713680000). panel format: 15m demo, 15m ambassador show-and-tell, 15m Q&A. invite community ambassadors as co-hosts.
rafael: prizes: small microgrants for 3 highlighted refapps per region + sticker packs. winners featured in a follow-up blog post with benchmark narratives.
priya: messaging test: run variant A (metrics-first) vs B (community-first) per region; measure signup->bench conversion. pick winners by day 3 and amplify in that region.
seth: for bench collection: two modes: 1) paste hosted `results.json` URL into form, 2) opt-in webhook that posts to `/api/bench/collect` with token. security: short-lived token in the form to prevent spam.
gina: I'll schedule social cadence and local partners (dev meetups) outreach. also short clip explainer for each region.
amy: owners: amy = program lead, rafael = repo & infra, priya = landing + localization, seth = lead routing & analytics, gina = socials & partners. deadlines: repo + bench scripts by Tue EOD, landing drafts Wed, localized assets Thu, webinars scheduled.
campaign-bot: Reminder: staging pages live by 1723520000 for QA.
amy: next sync Wed 9am PT. keep updates here only so we have a clean handoff. :rocket:
